annotations.title: Terminate External Building Cable Drops on Patch Panel

description: Terminate external building or room cable drops onto the rear RJ45 ports of a mounted patch panel without consuming rack U slots, and optionally auto-create labeled Cat6A front patch cables to a mounted switch. 'groups[]' batch-generates drops first—with 'custom_labels[]' overriding numbered 'label_prefix' entries per index—followed by 'endpoints[]', allocating sequential free rear ports from 'start_port_number' and sequential free switch RJ45 ports from 'auto_connect_switch_start_port'. Setting 'clear_existing' destructively removes prior external drops on 'patch_panel_instance_id' and their front patch cables before allocation, while unmounted patch-panel or switch IDs return status 'INVALID' without mutating state. Use for off-rack building wiring entering the enclosure; never mount room endpoints via mount_equipment, and use connect_cables for purely internal rack-to-rack links.

auto_connect_switch_start_port.description: 1-indexed starting Ethernet port number on auto_connect_switch_instance_id (e.g., 1 for eth1).

clear_existing.description: If true, destructively clears existing external_endpoints (and their front patch cables) on patch_panel_instance_id before planning.
